description: This file provides classes and functions to interact with Android devices via the fastboot protocol, including device management, variable retrieval, flashing, rebooting, and setting active slots.

classes.name: FastbootError
classes.description: Custom exception for errors related to fastboot interactions.

classes.name: FastbootDevice
classes.description: Class encapsulating methods to interact with a fastboot device, including device detection, variable retrieval, flashing, rebooting, and setting active slots.

methods.name: FastbootDevice.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the FastbootDevice instance, checks for fastboot executable and device presence.

methods.name: FastbootDevice._check_single_device
methods.description: Checks if exactly one fastboot device is connected, considering environment variables.

methods.name: FastbootDevice.getvar
methods.description: Retrieves a specific fastboot variable's value.

methods.name: FastbootDevice.getvar_all
methods.description: Retrieves all fastboot variables as a dictionary.

methods.name: FastbootDevice.flashall
methods.description: Flashes all images to the device, with options for wiping user data, slot selection, skipping secondary images, and quiet mode.

methods.name: FastbootDevice.flash
methods.description: Flashes a specific partition with an image, with options for slot and quiet mode.

methods.name: FastbootDevice.reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device, optionally into the bootloader.

methods.name: FastbootDevice.set_active
methods.description: Sets the active slot on the device.

methods.name: _get_subprocess_args
methods.description: Prepares command arguments for subprocess execution, handling Windows PowerShell Unicode issues.

methods.name: _subprocess_check_output
methods.description: Wrapper around subprocess.check_output to handle Windows Unicode workaround.
